I replied to Hollis in the #central-team thread. The reply confirms that expense reports are due this Friday, Oct 16; the simulation clock puts today at Wednesday, Oct 14. I also offered to put a reminder on their calendar for Thursday afternoon. I didn't create one, since they didn't ask.

GBrain had nothing about expense reports, and its search ran in keyword-only mode, so that doesn't prove there's no note on it. The Friday date comes from Hollis's message.
